description:
We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to architect and build core platform systems to accelerate Physical AI development, such as Autonomous Driving (AV) & Robotics. This is a technical role for someone with expertise at the intersection of data architecture, distributed systems, and Autonomous Vehicle development across cloud, local, and on-road environments. You will own deep technical areas end-to-end: such as AV/Robotics simulation infrastructure and AV performance evaluation.


What you will be doing:

  • Design and build simulation and evaluation infrastructure used by AV and ML engineers, to accelerate development of Level 4 self-driving capabilities.
  • Evolve efficient data formats for AV evaluation: designing for performance, interoperability, and correctness across formats like Protobuf, Arrow, Parquet, and MCAP.
  • Collaborate with AI and Robotics teams to deeply understand their simulation and evaluation needs.
  • Build reliable services, APIs, data pipelines, and AV simulation and evaluation workflows and framework that operate at the scale of hundreds of millions of runs per day.
  • Optimize performance at every level: profiling, parallelization, memory efficiency, query optimization, and protocol redesign.
  • Build diagnostic and observability tooling that enables teams to understand and debug their data and test pipelines.
  • Actively drive the adoption of new standards and technologies in the physical AI tooling ecosystem.

What We Need to See:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).
  • 15+ years of professional experience in software engineering with focus on distributed systems and data-intensive applications.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or Java, and experience operating across the full backend stack.
  • Deep experience building high-performance low-latency data systems: binary serialization, efficient data encoding, columnar data formats.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems: concurrency, consistency tradeoffs, latency optimization, and compute-efficient design.
  • Ability to identify and fix performance bottlenecks through optimization across the stack, including redesigning protocols and data models.
  • Experience designing and implementing workflows across distributed systems.
  • Past success building foundational systems that multiple teams depend on, with high reliability and scale.
  • Communication skills to be able to translate nuanced system design to both technical and non-technical partners, and talk to users in their language.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional projects, influence without authority, and get work done across organizational boundaries.

Ways to Stand Out from the crowd:

  • Experience building orchestration or workflow execution systems (e.g., Temporal.io, similar workflow engines)
  • Experience working with sensor data pipelines: ROS, MCAP, AV logs, Parquet, Apache Arrow, or similar domain formats
  • Understanding of AV & Robotics concepts such as kinematics, control systems, computer vision, motion planning, and/or neural networks
  • Experience improving legacy systems through incremental migration, deprecation, and architecture cleanup.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 272,000 USD – 431,250 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 6, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
